title: Open Source VC — repository record
description: Schema for a single curated entry in metadata/repositories.json. Fields sourced from the GitHub API are machine-verified and timestamped by metadata/snapshot.json's generated_at. Editorial fields come from curation.yaml and carry human judgement. A field that could not be verified MUST be 'unknown' rather than omitted or estimated.

name.description: Exact owner/repo identifier. Also the primary key and the attribution link back to the original project.

display_name.description: Short name used in tables and headings. Defaults to the repo slug.

github.description: Canonical upstream URL. Must resolve to the same owner/repo as 'name'.

description.description: One line. Editorial tagline where written, otherwise the upstream repository description verbatim.

tier.description: Editorial label. Deliberately qualitative — there are no numeric scores. Definitions in METHODOLOGY.md.

kind.description: What the artefact is. Distinguishes a runnable tool from data, a spec, or something read rather than deployed.

vc_use_case.description: The specific analyst task this replaces or accelerates, and who performs it. Generic phrasing ('useful for investors') is a validation failure in spirit if not in code.

why_it_is_interesting.description: What it does that the obvious alternative does not.

limitations.description: Caveats: rate limits, licence terms, maintenance risk, cost, missing features. Null only when genuinely none could be identified.

license.description: SPDX identifier as published upstream, or 'unknown' / 'unverified (<name>)' when no licence file was detectable. Never guessed.

license_name.description: Licence name as reported by the GitHub API, before SPDX normalisation.

stars.description: GitHub API stargazers_count at snapshot time. A fact, not a quality claim.

contributors.description: 'unknown' for most entries: the contributor endpoint is expensive and rate-limited, and an estimate would be worse than a gap.

last_commit.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the upstream pushed_at, or 'unknown'.

language.description: Primary language as reported upstream, or 'unknown'.

status.description: Derived only from verified fields: Active / Dormant / Archived / Disabled, with the date it was derived from.

archived.description: Upstream archived flag. True is a validation error for a listed entry.

self_hostable.description: 'partial' means an open core with commercial hosted extras.

commercial_restrictions.description: What the licence implies for redistribution and commercial use. A report of the licence text, not legal advice.

owner_type.description: GitHub owner type (User / Organization) — a weak signal of project backing.

links_verified.description: Date the entry's links were last checked live, or 'unknown'.

vc_native.description: Built explicitly for venture capital or private markets. False is not a criticism — it usually means lower cost.

ai.description: Whether the core function depends on a model, rather than AI being bolted on.

hidden_gem.description: Included in HIDDEN_GEMS.md. Excluded from star-based ranking by design.
